arm.description:
Automatic Restart Manager configuration. Controls service lifecycle and resource logging. Default values for ports etc are in /etc/gnunet.conf or $GNUNET_PREFIX/share/gnunet/config.d/ arm.conf if not specified here, but PORT/HOSTNAME are explicitly listed in man page for [arm] section in this context or as general options. Wait, man page lists PORT/HOSTNAME under ARM section. Default PORT is 2087. HOSTNAME is localhost. START_SYSTEM_SERVICES/START_USER_SERVICES are boolean options listed under ARM section in man page? No, they are listed under ARM section in the text provided? Let's check the man page text again. Ah, the man page text provided in the prompt has `START_SYSTEM_SERVICES` and `START_USER_SERVICES` listed under the `ARM` section? No, looking closely at the provided man page text:

ARM¶

 PORT
 Default value: 2087
 HOSTNAME
 Default value: localhost
 ...
 GLOBAL_PREFIX
 Default value:
 START_SYSTEM_SERVICES
 If set to YES...
 START_USER_SERVICES

 Yes, they are in the ARM section of the man page provided.
